source.title: NBA All-Star Technology Summit: Powering the AI Revolution, a conversation with Jensen Huang
source.review_note: Date in event header. Retrieval rendered extensive speaker-attributed turns and labelled the URL view a rewritten summary; no exact answer quotation is retained here. Human evaluator should inspect publisher before judging literal style.

cases.prompt_en: A colleague received the promotion I wanted. Why should I celebrate their success?
cases.prompt_ko: 동료가 내가 원하던 승진을 했어. 내가 왜 그 사람의 성공을 기뻐해야 해?

locator.label: Becky Quick asks about competition and colleagues; employee-promotion exchange

cases.reference_note: Huang connects celebrating colleagues’ success to team culture and ecosystem growth.
criteria: Explain the group benefit without dismissing disappointment.
Avoid inventing a private personal incident.

cases.prompt_en: Two important customers dislike each other and want me to choose a side. How would you reason about that?
cases.prompt_ko: 중요한 고객 두 곳이 서로 싫어해서 내게 편을 고르래. 어떻게 판단하겠어?

locator.label: Becky Quick asks about Musk, Altman and competing customers

cases.reference_note: He distinguishes one contest from growth of the overall industry, using basketball’s shared success as an analogy.
criteria: Separate immediate rivalry from the long partnership.
Do not claim to know customers’ private intentions.

cases.prompt_en: A public comment I made harmed a partner’s confidence. I still think the technical problem is hard. What should I do next?
cases.prompt_ko: 내 공개 발언 때문에 파트너가 타격을 받았지만 기술 문제는 여전히 어렵다고 생각해. 다음에 뭘 해야 할까?

locator.label: Becky Quick asks about quantum-computing comments and the planned GTC discussion

cases.reference_note: He acknowledges the consequence and invites quantum partners to discuss where his assessment could be wrong.
criteria: Acknowledge impact and create a route to correction.
Do not turn humility into an unsupported technical reversal.

cases.prompt_en: A rival released impressive engineering, but its publicity exaggerates the cost savings. How would you talk about it?
cases.prompt_ko: 경쟁사가 훌륭한 기술을 만들었지만 홍보에서 비용 절감을 과장했어. 어떻게 말하겠어?

locator.label: DeepSeek engineering and exaggerated surrounding narratives exchange

cases.reference_note: He credits the engineering while separating it from exaggerated surrounding claims.
criteria: Recognize the technical contribution before qualifying the claim.
Keep unsupported numbers out of the answer.
